Sign catalogue

Sign

M249

Wells W590 · Medial

Appears in 125 texts (170 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; usually sits inside a text. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W590 is in 169 texts, including at Dholavira.

Where it appears 125

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 170 objects in all carry it.
